payload.name: Kane and Kash Adapt
payload.description:
Kane and Kash Adapt modifies popular, culturally relevant toys so children with physical disabilities and special needs can enjoy the same play experiences as their peers — not different toys, but the sameones, made accessible.

Every toy we adapt is switch-modified with care, tested for safety, and made available at prices families can actually afford. Because accessibility shouldn't come with a luxury price tag.
